mapper.insert: insert into mentors (id, user_id, headline, company, industries, expertise, availability, max_chats_per_week, points, photo_url, years_experience) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{headline}, #{company}, #{industries,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.StringListTypeHandler}, #{expertise,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.StringListTypeHandler}, #{availability,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.SlotListTypeHandler}, #{maxChatsPerWeek}, #{points}, #{photoUrl}, #{yearsExperience})
mapper.update: update mentors set headline = #{headline}, company = #{company}, industries = #{industries,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.StringListTypeHandler}, expertise = #{expertise,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.StringListTypeHandler}, availability = #{availability,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.SlotListTypeHandler}, max_chats_per_week = #{maxChatsPerWeek}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, years_experience = #{yearsExperience} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from mentors order by points desc, id
